detail: Manifested while field-testing the Triage tab on a standalone branch-build server: /api/triage (backend-aware createStores per TRIAGE-SPEC §7) listed live sqlite data while the pre-existing /api/blackboard/:id detail route (file-store fallback in query-routes.ts createQueryHandler) returned 404 "Blackboard entry not found" for the same entries. Not a triage bug; not a production bug (src/index.ts always injects dashboardDeps). The legacy-route fallback wart is documented in TRIAGE-SPEC §7 and the 2026-07-22 review (round-1 minor finding). Correct harness: const { dashboardDeps } = createServer(projectRoot); startDashboard(projectRoot, dashboardDeps).
summary: Standalone dashboard testing gotcha: startDashboard without deps hits legacy file-store fallbacks — on sqlite projects legacy detail routes 404 on live entries. Pass createServer(root).dashboardDeps.
